name: PaperFamiliar offline demo
assumptions: Every manuscript in this demo is synthetic and was written for testing; no real paper is included.
Demo-only: the synthetic draft is treated as the author's own prose so that style cards can be shown. In a real workspace the default label is 'unknown' and unknown sections are excluded.
The demo contains deliberate errors: an undefined citation, a duplicate label, an undefined reference, a misattributed real citation, and prompt-injection text in a comment.
